metadata.title: Tamil Nadu Industrial Policy Outcomes Observatory
metadata.causal_note: The observatory describes outcomes before and after policies. It does not claim the policy caused the observed change.
metadata.price_note: Current rupees. Monetary growth rates must not be described as real growth until deflators are applied.
metadata.disclosure_note: Public JSON requires at least 10 sampled factories and no factory contributing more than 70 percent of absolute weighted GVA in the cell.

evidence_classes.independent_direct: A non-implementing official statistical source measures the same outcome and deadline.
evidence_classes.independent_partial: An official survey measures a relevant subset, but not the policy's exact universe or attribution.
evidence_classes.official_proxy: An official series exists, but its geography or concept differs from the target.
evidence_classes.administrative_required: A verdict requires project-level records held by the implementing department.
evidence_classes.directional: The policy states an ambition without a numeric outcome, deadline, or testable denominator.

employees.label: People engaged
employees.note: Estimated people engaged in registered factories.

gva_output_ratio.label: Value-added share
gva_output_ratio.note: Gross value added divided by gross output.

female_direct_worker_share.label: Women among direct workers
female_direct_worker_share.note: Women divided by all directly employed workers.

contract_worker_share.label: Contract-worker share
contract_worker_share.note: Contract workers divided by all workers.

rd_gva_share.label: R&D intensity
rd_gva_share.note: Reported R&D expenditure divided by GVA; available from 2015-16.

training_factory_share.label: Factories providing training
training_factory_share.note: Share of reporting factories with formal training; available from 2020-21.

sectors.label: Aerospace and selected defence manufacturing
sectors.limitation: Many dual-use suppliers sit in broader engineering industries and cannot be identified from NIC alone.

sectors.label: All registered manufacturing
sectors.limitation: ASI covers registered factories and selected related establishments, not informal manufacturing.

sectors.label: Motor vehicles, bodies and components
sectors.limitation: ASI does not identify electric powertrains separately from conventional vehicles.

sectors.label: Computer, electronic and optical products
sectors.limitation: Semiconductor fabrication and design cannot be cleanly separated from other electronic components in ASI.

sectors.label: Food processing and beverages
sectors.limitation: Includes beverage manufacturing; agricultural production and informal processors are outside ASI.

sectors.label: Leather and footwear
sectors.limitation: Covers registered manufacturing, not retail or home-based production.

sectors.label: Pharmaceuticals and medical devices
sectors.limitation: Biotechnology services and standalone R&D centres outside registered factories are not covered.

sectors.label: Materials recovery
sectors.limitation: Captures recovery establishments covered by ASI, not circular practices within other factories.

sectors.label: Ships and boats
sectors.limitation: Does not include every marine supplier or port service.

sectors.label: Textiles and apparel
sectors.limitation: Technical textiles cannot be consistently separated across every year.

sectors.label: Games and toys
sectors.limitation: Small cells require three-year pooling and disclosure suppression.

policies.title: New Industrial Policy 2007
policies.issuer: Industries Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
policies.coverage_note: ASI measures registered factories; GSVA measures the full manufacturing economy.

targets.statement: Create 2 million additional jobs by 2011.
targets.assessment: The baseline and job universe are not specified, so the increment cannot be reconstructed exactly.

targets.statement: Raise manufacturing's GSDP share from 21% to 27% by 2011.
targets.outcome_dataset: Tamil Nadu DES state domestic product
targets.assessment: Testable in principle, but the current 2011-12-base series starts after the deadline; an archived vintage is required.

targets.statement: Double annual exports to Rs 140,000 crore by 2011.
targets.assessment: Customs origin is not validated as state of production, so it is a proxy rather than proof.

policies.title: Micro, Small and Medium Industries Policy 2008
policies.issuer: Small Industries Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
policies.coverage_note: ASI has no stable MSME flag; enterprise definitions changed and informal firms are outside ASI.

targets.statement: Sustain annual MSME growth above 10%.
targets.assessment: The policy does not define whether growth means units, output, employment or value added.

targets.statement: Promote 10 lakh direct and indirect jobs during the XI Plan.
targets.outcome_dataset: Employment surveys plus historical MSME records
targets.assessment: Indirect jobs and policy attribution are not observable in a standard public series.

policies.title: Tamil Nadu Automobile and Auto Components Policy 2014
policies.issuer: Industries Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
policies.coverage_note: ASI identifies motor vehicles and components but not the full supply chain or indirect employment.

targets.statement: Generate about 5 lakh additional automobile and component jobs by 2015.
targets.assessment: ASI is a defensible registered-factory lower bound, not the policy's full direct-and-indirect universe.

targets.statement: Double automobile and component exports by 2016.
targets.outcome_dataset: DGCIS commodity exports by customs origin
targets.assessment: Product coverage can be defined, but state origin remains a proxy.

policies.title: Tamil Nadu Biotechnology Policy 2014
policies.issuer: Industries Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
policies.coverage_note: ASI captures pharmaceuticals and some medical devices, not biotech services or standalone research.

policies.title: Tamil Nadu Export Strategy 2014
policies.issuer: Government of Tamil Nadu
policies.coverage_note: Direct-export share in ASI is diagnostic; DGCIS state origin is not validated production geography.

targets.statement: Double exports from USD 35.9 billion to USD 70 billion within five years.
targets.assessment: Useful for monitoring, not a clean state-production outcome.

policies.title: Tamil Nadu Industrial Policy 2014
policies.issuer: Industries Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
policies.coverage_note: GSVA tests economy-wide growth; ASI decomposes registered-factory outcomes.

targets.statement: Achieve 14% annual average manufacturing growth.
targets.assessment: From 2014-15 to 2020-21, CAGR was 9.7% nominal and 8.5% real. The target did not specify a price basis; it was below 14% on both.

targets.statement: Create 2 million additional jobs before 2016.
targets.assessment: The baseline and coverage of 'gainful employment' are not defined.

targets.statement: Double Tamil Nadu exports by 2016.
targets.assessment: State export origin is a customs proxy and cannot establish where production occurred.

policies.title: Tamil Nadu Food Processing Policy 2018
policies.issuer: Government of Tamil Nadu
policies.coverage_note: ASI can track registered food and beverage factories, jobs, capital and value addition. The policy has no headline numeric outcome target.

policies.title: Tamil Nadu Information Technology Policy 2018
policies.issuer: Information Technology Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
policies.coverage_note: IT and ITeS are services outside ASI. PLFS, STPI exports and company records are the relevant sources; the policy has no headline numeric outcome target.

policies.title: Tamil Nadu Startup and Innovation Policy 2018-23
policies.issuer: MSME Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
policies.coverage_note: Startup recognition is an administrative status, not an ASI concept.

targets.statement: Facilitate at least 5,000 startups, including 10 global high-growth startups, by 2023.
targets.outcome_dataset: StartupTN registry reconciled with DPIIT Startup India
targets.assessment: A credible verdict requires deduplication, survival checks and a pre-specified definition of 'global high growth'.

policies.title: Tamil Nadu Electric Vehicle Policy 2019
policies.issuer: Industries Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
policies.coverage_note: ASI cannot separate electric from conventional vehicle manufacturing.

targets.statement: Attract Rs 50,000 crore in EV manufacturing and create 1.5 lakh jobs.
targets.outcome_dataset: Guidance project ledger with commissioning, investment and payroll evidence
targets.assessment: The document calls jobs 'expected' and gives no target deadline; MoUs alone cannot verify realization.

policies.title: Tamil Nadu New Integrated Textile Policy 2019
policies.issuer: Handlooms, Handicrafts, Textiles and Khadi Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
policies.coverage_note: ASI covers registered textiles and apparel but not handloom and home-based production.

targets.statement: Double the share of textile exports from Tamil Nadu.
targets.outcome_dataset: DGCIS textile exports by customs origin
targets.assessment: No deadline or denominator is specified, preventing a pass/fail verdict.

policies.title: Tamil Nadu Solar Energy Policy 2019
policies.issuer: Energy Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
policies.coverage_note: Electricity capacity is outside ASI and is directly measured by MNRE.

targets.statement: Reach 9,000 MW of installed solar capacity by 2023.
targets.assessment: MNRE reported 6,736.43 MW on 31 March 2023, 74.85% of target and 2,263.57 MW short.

targets.statement: Earmark 40% of the 9,000 MW target for consumer-category systems.
targets.assessment: MNRE technology categories do not map cleanly to the policy's consumer-category definition, so this is not scored.

policies.title: Tamil Nadu Electronics Hardware Manufacturing Policy 2020
policies.issuer: Industries Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
policies.coverage_note: ASI measures registered electronics factories but not the full ESDM ecosystem or state-wide sector turnover.

targets.statement: Increase electronics industry output to USD 100 billion by 2025.
targets.outcome_dataset: Firm-level production or GST turnover ledger
targets.assessment: ASI output is a useful lower bound but does not match the policy universe.

targets.statement: Contribute 25% of India's electronics exports by 2025.
targets.outcome_dataset: DGCIS electronics exports by customs origin
targets.assessment: The numerator is customs origin, not verified production origin.

targets.statement: Train more than 100,000 people by 2024.
targets.assessment: Counts require unique learners, completion and placement outcomes.

targets.statement: Attract at least two major semiconductor fabs within three years.
targets.assessment: A press announcement or MoU is not a commissioned fab.

policies.title: Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Policy 2021
policies.issuer: MSME Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
policies.coverage_note: ASI cannot apply the turnover-and-investment MSME definition consistently across years.

targets.statement: Attract Rs 2,00,000 crore of new MSME investment by 2025.
targets.outcome_dataset: Udyam and state incentive records with realization checks
targets.assessment: Registration declarations are not verified realized investment.

targets.statement: Create 20 lakh additional MSME employment opportunities.
targets.assessment: No deadline is stated and survey estimates cannot attribute jobs to the policy.

targets.statement: Increase the share of MSME exports from Tamil Nadu by 25%.
targets.assessment: There is no public annual state export series linked to MSME status.

policies.title: Tamil Nadu Data Centre Policy 2021
policies.issuer: Industries Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
policies.coverage_note: Data centres are services outside ASI. The policy states directional goals without a headline numeric state outcome.

policies.title: Tamil Nadu Export Promotion Strategy 2021
policies.issuer: Government of Tamil Nadu
policies.coverage_note: ASI direct-export shares illuminate factory orientation; DGCIS provides only a state-origin proxy.

targets.statement: Increase exports from USD 26 billion in 2021 to USD 100 billion by 2030.
targets.assessment: Trackable as an official proxy, but not independently verified production within Tamil Nadu.

policies.title: Tamil Nadu FinTech Policy 2021
policies.issuer: Information Technology Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
policies.coverage_note: FinTech is outside ASI; MCA incorporation and administrative infrastructure records are relevant.

targets.statement: Develop a FinTech city with at least 1 million square feet of workspace.
targets.assessment: Built, certified and occupied area should be reported separately.

targets.statement: Become the leading state in growth of newly incorporated FinTech firms during the policy period.
targets.outcome_dataset: MCA company registrations with a reproducible FinTech classifier
targets.assessment: FinTech has no clean industry code; rankings depend on a disclosed text classifier and peer universe.

policies.title: Tamil Nadu Industrial Policy 2021
policies.issuer: Industries Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
policies.coverage_note: GSVA tests statewide manufacturing outcomes; ASI explains registered-factory composition without claiming causality.

targets.statement: Achieve 15% annual manufacturing growth during the policy term.
targets.assessment: From 2020-21 to 2023-24, CAGR was 13.4% nominal and 8.3% real. The target omits the price basis; both are below 15% through the latest comparable year.

targets.statement: Attract Rs 10 lakh crore of investment between 2020 and 2025.
targets.assessment: ASI GFCF is an independent outcome check, but cannot identify policy-assisted projects or all investment.

targets.statement: Create 20 lakh employment opportunities by 2025.
targets.assessment: Neither source identifies policy-created jobs; administrative payroll evidence is needed for attribution.

targets.statement: Raise manufacturing to 30% of GSVA by 2030.
targets.assessment: Manufacturing was 18.57% of current-price GSVA and 24.10% at constant prices in 2023-24. The target is not yet due and does not specify price basis.

policies.title: Tamil Nadu Aerospace and Defence Industrial Policy 2022
policies.issuer: Industries Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
policies.coverage_note: ASI's narrow NIC definition misses dual-use suppliers and many defence services.

targets.statement: Attract Rs 75,000 crore and nearly 1 lakh direct and indirect jobs over ten years.
targets.outcome_dataset: Project commissioning, audited fixed assets and payroll records
targets.assessment: ASI is a lower-bound trend check; indirect jobs and policy attribution require a documented model.

policies.title: Tamil Nadu Footwear and Leather Products Policy 2022
policies.issuer: Industries Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
policies.coverage_note: ASI captures registered manufacturing, while the policy's employment ambition may include a wider cluster economy.

targets.statement: Attract Rs 20,000 crore and 2 lakh footwear jobs.
targets.assessment: No deadline is stated. ASI employment is an independent registered-factory outcome, not proof of target delivery.

policies.title: Tamil Nadu Lifesciences Promotion Policy 2022
policies.issuer: Industries Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
policies.coverage_note: ASI covers pharmaceuticals and selected medical devices, not the whole life-sciences ecosystem.

targets.statement: Attract Rs 20,000 crore and generate 50,000 life-sciences jobs.
targets.assessment: No deadline is stated; ASI can provide sector trends but not a target verdict.

policies.title: Tamil Nadu R&D Policy 2022
policies.issuer: Industries Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
policies.coverage_note: ASI captures factory R&D expenditure from 2015-16; it excludes universities, government laboratories and standalone service R&D.

targets.statement: Double state R&D expenditure across government, higher education and the private sector by 2030.
targets.outcome_dataset: DST Research and Development Statistics plus ASI
targets.assessment: A defensible baseline must be fixed before testing; DST state estimates are infrequent and ASI covers only factory R&D.

policies.title: Special Scheme for Technical Textiles and MMF Manufacturing 2023
policies.issuer: Government of Tamil Nadu
policies.coverage_note: The document defines project eligibility thresholds and subsidies, not a state-level outcome target. ASI cannot isolate technical textiles consistently.

policies.title: Tamil Nadu Electric Vehicles Policy 2023
policies.issuer: Industries Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
policies.coverage_note: ASI cannot identify EV powertrains separately.

targets.statement: Attract Rs 50,000 crore of EV investment and create 1.5 lakh jobs during the policy period.
targets.outcome_dataset: Guidance project ledger with audited investment and payroll
targets.assessment: MoU amounts are commitments, not realized investment; the policy is not yet due.

policies.title: Tamil Nadu Ethanol Blending Policy 2023
policies.issuer: Industries Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
policies.coverage_note: ASI can observe registered distillery activity only within broader beverage/chemical classifications; capacity and procurement data are better suited.

targets.statement: Become self-sufficient for an estimated 130 crore litres of blending requirement.
targets.outcome_dataset: DFPD/OMC contracted supply and commissioned capacity
targets.assessment: Installed capacity, contracted supply and actual delivery must not be conflated.

targets.statement: Attract Rs 5,000 crore in ethanol production capacity.
targets.assessment: The policy is not yet due; approvals and announcements are not realized investment.

policies.title: Tamil Nadu Logistics Policy and Integrated Logistics Plan 2023
policies.issuer: Industries Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
policies.coverage_note: The policy lists outcomes such as lower logistics cost but sets no numeric baseline or deadline. ASI does not cover the logistics service economy.

policies.title: Tamil Nadu M-Sand Policy 2023
policies.issuer: Government of Tamil Nadu
policies.coverage_note: The policy is regulatory and states no headline numeric state outcome. Mining and quarrying are outside the observatory's ASI manufacturing panel.

policies.title: Tamil Nadu Semiconductor and Advanced Electronics Policy 2024
policies.issuer: Industries Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
policies.coverage_note: ASI cannot cleanly separate semiconductor fabrication, design and packaging from broader electronics and is available only through 2023-24.

targets.statement: Contribute 40% of India's electronics exports by 2030.
targets.outcome_dataset: DGCIS electronics exports by customs origin
targets.assessment: State-origin exports are a proxy; the target is not yet due.

targets.statement: Create a skilled sector talent pool of 2 lakh people by 2030.
targets.outcome_dataset: Unique training completions and sector placements
targets.assessment: Training counts alone do not establish a skilled employed talent pool.

policies.title: Tamil Nadu Integrated Textile Policy 2025-26
policies.issuer: Handlooms, Handicrafts, Textiles and Khadi Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
policies.coverage_note: The policy sets directional short-, medium- and long-term goals without headline numeric state outcomes. Post-policy ASI data do not yet exist.

policies.title: Tamil Nadu Space Industrial Policy 2025
policies.issuer: Industries Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
policies.coverage_note: ASI is a narrow manufacturing lower bound and predates the policy.

targets.statement: Attract Rs 10,000 crore and nearly 10,000 direct and indirect jobs within five years.
targets.assessment: No post-policy ASI observation exists yet; indirect jobs require a disclosed model.

policies.title: Tamil Nadu Toy Manufacturing Policy 2025
policies.issuer: Industries Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
policies.coverage_note: ASI toy cells are too small for annual disclosure and the data predate the policy.

targets.statement: Attract at least 10 anchor toy manufacturers and establish a dedicated toy park.
targets.outcome_dataset: Commissioned anchor projects and park-operational records
targets.assessment: The policy defines neither 'anchor' nor a deadline; announcements should not be counted as operating projects.

policies.title: Tamil Nadu Circular Economy Investment Policy 2026
policies.issuer: Industries Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
policies.coverage_note: The policy's Rs 20 crore and 25-job figures are project eligibility thresholds, not state outcome targets. Post-policy data do not yet exist.

policies.title: Tamil Nadu Shipbuilding Policy 2026
policies.issuer: Industries Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
policies.coverage_note: The policy's numeric figures are project eligibility conditions, not state outcome targets. Existing ASI shipbuilding cells are disclosure-suppressed.

solar.source_agency: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy, Government of India
solar.method_note: The total-capacity target is directly comparable with the MNRE state total as at 31 March 2023. The policy's separate 40 percent consumer-category earmark is not scored because MNRE technology categories do not map cleanly to the policy's consumer-category definition.

benchmark_validation.scope_note: MoSPI benchmarks cover the full reported factory sector. The validation frame keeps status 1-3 units and NIC divisions 10-38, so a small systematic shortfall is expected. The test detects formula or schema failures, not exact table replication.
